}} The '''L. Light String''' is a piece of [[furniture]] that hangs on a wall. It can rotate into daily stock at the [[Carpenter's Shop]] for {{Price|400}}, or be purchased from [[Pierre]]'s booth at the [[Feast of the Winter Star]] for {{Price|800}}. It's also available from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}.
